anchors.title: Independent anchors
anchors.localNotice: The demo stores Ed25519 receipts in a separate witness store. Export bundles and keep the key fingerprint independently. Time comes from the local machine; no TSA or blockchain is connected.
anchors.invalidBundle: Choose a valid JSON file up to 1 MB.
anchors.MATCH: Receipt, signature and audit anchor match.
anchors.MISMATCH: Anchor mismatch. Check the bundle source and history.
anchors.snapshotSame: Current data matches the anchored snapshot.
anchors.snapshotChanged: Current data differs from the older snapshot. Reconcile activity since the anchor; legitimate updates can cause differences.

extraction.title: Extract and review terms
extraction.notice: Document reading produces suggestions. Review values, pages and quotes; correct or complete them before confirming and locking terms.
extraction.noDocument: This demo record has a filename but no original bytes. Review the values manually.
extraction.noText: No readable text is available for automatic quote matching. For a scan, check the proposed value and quote against the page image.
extraction.aiNotice: AI suggests; the reviewer confirms. AI does not approve or change payment decisions.

flow.done: Terms confirmed. Continue reviewing the payment milestones below.
flow.readHint: Read the value, dates, grace period and penalty terms in the actual PDF. Continue after you have reviewed and understood the document.
flow.reviewAck: I have compared the confirmed values with their pages and the document contents.

hints.read: Step 1 · Open “Read document first”, review the PDF, then acknowledge that you have read it.
hints.extract: Step 2 · Select “Extract terms” to read the data from the file.
hints.load: Step 3 · Load suggestions into empty fields, then compare each value with its source. Complete anything that could not be extracted.
hints.review: Step 3 · Check all six values, correct them if needed, and acknowledge your review before confirming.
hints.confirm: Step 4 · Select “Confirm and apply to draft”, then review the milestones and continue to signing.

rules.title: Rule and template versions
rules.name: Version name
rules.reasonPlaceholder: Describe the change and its business basis.
rules.author: Author
rules.notice: Versions must preserve all 405 baseline results, match 20 samples and pass invariants. Another administrator publishes. This does not verify hidden ground truth.
rules.search: Search name, rationale or version hash
rules.publishConfirm: Publish this validated configuration. It is assigned to newly saved unpinned drafts; previously pinned contracts are unchanged.
rules.tampered: Configuration hash mismatch. Do not use this version.
rules.editorNotice: Percentages must total 100% per workflow. Specification scopes, priorities, decisions and reason codes stay fixed. Expressions are checked before review.
rules.percentTotal: A workflow’s payment percentages do not total 100%.
rules.percentHint: Enter 0–100 with up to 2 decimal places.
rules.expressionRequired: Enter an expression up to 2,000 characters.
rules.previewScope: {{templates}} template changes (new contracts only). Submission requires unchanged decisions, reasons, statuses and amounts across the full pack.
rules.demoReason: Demo input: preview impact before requesting review; no business outcome change is proposed.

language.order: Apply the first matching rule, in priority order 10 → 80
language.orderDetail: Stop at the first matching rule in the selected scope. Calculate penalty first, then payable. ELSE is the fallback when no earlier rule matches.
language.catalogError: Unable to load the engine vocabulary. Retry to insert variables and inspect units.
language.valid: Syntax, types and units valid · {{count}} expressions
language.syntaxOnly: Types and units are checked; preview all 405 milestones to verify results and data-dependent errors.
language.unchecked: This revision has not been checked. Recheck after every edit.
language.lockedMetadata: Scope, priority, decision and reason code are locked to the Data Pack. The reference description does not update automatically when expressions change.
language.modified: Expression differs from the saved revision. Review its meaning and preview before submitting.
language.vocabularyHint: A limited DSL, not arbitrary JavaScript, Excel or Python. The engine derives variables from data; the browser does not decide payments.
language.syntaxHint: AND joins booleans with spaces on each side. Use decimal dots (0.10), uppercase TRUE/FALSE. MIN/MAX take 1–8 numeric arguments. ELSE stands alone at priority 80. OR, NOT, IF, strings, property access and other functions are unsupported.
language.dateHint: Add only whole calendar days to dates, e.g. due_date + grace_period_days. No money, percentages or counts. Use days_late_after_grace instead of subtracting dates; missing completion yields FALSE in comparisons.
language.exampleInputs: Planned payment 1000.00 million VND, 3 days late after grace, 0.10% daily penalty, cap 8%. Applies only if the penalty rule matches first.
language.exampleResult: Penalty 3.00 million VND, payable 997.00 million VND. The engine uses Decimal with 2-decimal ROUND_HALF_UP. An open dispute triggers HOLD at priority 10, regardless of this example.
language.previewFirst: Preview this revision and address blockers before submitting.

hints.condition_expression: Returns TRUE/FALSE; final rule uses ELSE. Lower priorities run first.
hints.penalty_amount_formula: Million VND. Convert percentages using / 100 or × 0.01; MIN caps the result. Computed penalty cannot reference itself here.
hints.payable_amount_formula: May use the rounded penalty from step 1. MAX(0, …) avoids negative payable.

errors.UNKNOWN_VARIABLE: Unknown variable “{{token}}”. Select from the vocabulary.
errors.VARIABLE_UNAVAILABLE: “{{token}}” is available only in the payable formula, after penalty calculation.
errors.SYNTAX_ERROR: Invalid syntax. Check brackets, operators, decimal dots and spaces around AND.
errors.INVALID_CONSTANT: Only finite numbers up to 16 characters or TRUE/FALSE; no strings or Python True/False.
errors.INVALID_COMPARISON: Use one comparison operator per expression; combine with AND.
errors.TYPE_MISMATCH: Type mismatch: compare matching types; add days to dates or use numeric arithmetic.
errors.BOOLEAN_REQUIRED: Conditions and AND operands must return booleans.
errors.NUMBER_REQUIRED: Money formulas and MIN/MAX arguments must be numeric.
errors.DIVISION_BY_ZERO: Division by zero is not allowed.
errors.FALLBACK_ORDER: ELSE is only allowed at priority 80.
errors.UNIT_MISMATCH: Unit mismatch: do not add money to days/counts. Money formulas must return million VND; dates accept only days.
errors.PERCENT_CONVERSION_REQUIRED: Unconverted percent: use / 100 (or × 0.01) before producing a money amount.
errors.INTEGER_DAYS_REQUIRED: Date offsets must be whole days; fractional days are never truncated.
errors.NEGATIVE_AMOUNT: A constant money formula cannot return a negative amount.

language.unitHint: Addition, subtraction, comparisons and MIN/MAX require compatible units. Days × %/day ÷ 100 × money yields money. Fixed numbers such as 0 in MAX(0, money) inherit the other operand’s unit; constant-only money formulas mean million VND.

rules.previewChanges: Inspect up to 30 changed milestones (million VND)
